user.title: Teach EnOcean rocker switch
user.description: Choose the rocker type. Afterwards you will press two of its keys.

timeout.title: No rocker detected
timeout.description: No rocker switch detected. Submit to try again.

timeout_second.title: Second key not pressed
timeout_second.description: Rocker {address} detected, but the second key (**{target}**) was not pressed. Submit to try again.

pick.title: Select rocker
pick.description: Several senders were received. Select the rocker switch you pressed.

wrong_second.title: Wrong key
wrong_second.description: Submit and press the **{target}** key again.

progress.press_first: Press the **{target}** key now. (Listening for up to 30 s.)
progress.press_second: Press the **{target}** key now. (Listening for up to 30 s.)

error.same_button: That was the same key as before - please press the opposite one.
error.wrong_pair: That was not the opposite key - please press again.

abort.not_connected: The EnOcean stick is not connected or `enoceanbt` is not set up in configuration.yaml.
abort.already_configured: This rocker switch has already been taught.
abort.already_in_progress: A teach-in for this rocker switch is already in progress.
